reviews.title: Dreadful, dreadful, dreadful.
reviews.text: We were originally booked on Israir's late evening flight from DXB to TLV, in order to enjoy another day in the city. The evening prior to our flight, we logged in to check in for the flight and were horrified to learn the flight had been cancelled. We received no notification from the airline regarding this, and they just automatically rebooked us on the early morning flight back home. It's a good thing we checked, as otherwise, we'd been stranded there. The flight itself was chaotic, with a very unprofessional crew (and some nasty passengers to match). Everything (including water) is chargeable. There was no entertainment, of course. Never again.
reviews.author: TheShis

reviews.title: Worst company ever.
reviews.text: Never ever ever on time. With them it's always delayed or they will lose your language and won't respond until you take to court. 5 out 5 times that I flew with them they missed up, never showed any care. For your own sake, don't fly with them.
reviews.author: Ruby Feld

reviews.title: 2nd of 2 flights also delayed
reviews.text: So this is my second review of this airline as it’s my return trip to Tel Aviv. Again, the flight is delayed an hour. There’s no explanation. There was no advance warning. 3 hours out it was listed as on time. So we are at this tiny airport with two hours to wait instead of one. The other important issue for travelers is that other than the sales platform no communications are in English. Everything is in Hebrew. We had to have help from a friend and then from a hotel concierge to check into our flights. There was absolutely no translated platform or English language option for anything other than sales. So I absolutely do not recommend this airline. Arkia is a much better option. It has 64 flights daily and Israir has two. Arkia flights are on time. Had I known that I would’ve flown with Arkia. At least the view from the airport in Eilat is gorgeous. We are right on the border with Jordan and you can see the mountains. And this tiny airport in a lot is brand new and quite clean. So it could be a lot worse.
reviews.author: Kathryn H

reviews.title: Do not fly with Israir
reviews.text: I booked israir over Ackria because of the scheduling. And then week before our trip which was booked two months out. Israir canceled our early morning flight and put us on a late morning flight. when we got to the airport. It had become an afternoon flight, and then the flight was delayed again at the gate. There was almost no explanation. Really disgusting and uncaring.
reviews.author: Kathryn H

reviews.title: Cheap flight that cost like regular flight
reviews.text: It was not a pleasure at all all. from the beginning they didn't pay the tunnels and we had to take a bus to the plain. They also send him to early and coming 30 minutes before boarder time was late somehow. On flight you don't get even water and it felt like a low-cost that i never fly with,
reviews.author: Luchy F

reviews.title: Beware of web site and hand luggage weight
reviews.text: 1. The English web site is absolutely hopeless, missing most features. Instead use the Israeli/Hebrew web site, and use Google Chrome ro translate 2. On the return from Sharm El Sheikh to Tel Aviv (but interestingly not on the outbound flight), the check in staff forced us to weigh our carry on bags. They charged us$30 per kilo or part thereof for anything over rhe 8kg limit. Since we had no checked bags, this resulted in us having to wear multiple layers of clothes, and putting heavier stuff in our pockets. Be warned. Otherwise it was exactly as you would expect from a budget airline.
reviews.author: Howard T

reviews.title: Why do they shoot themselves in the foot?
reviews.text: I flew on flight 661 from TLV to DXB several days ago on a nice Airbus 320. The aircraft was clean and seemed well maintained with a friendly crew. Legroom in coach was acceptable (I am 6 ft tall). However, I paid beforehand extra to select seats but never got the seats I paid for!
reviews.author: David R

reviews.title: Do not use Israir!!
reviews.text: Left stranded at Sharm El Sheikh airport as Israir claim you cannot fly to Israel unless you arrived to Egypt from Sharm El Sheikh. There was no mention of this when purchasing tickets. The security that work for Israir were so rude, especially the female with the long brown hair. The female security was also taking pictures of us and others in the queue, we did not give her permission to take our photo and I have no idea in the point of this. We were treated like criminals, as if we had done something wrong but we now know this is a regular occurrence as there were many others left stranded. The airport door security even have a system they use to make money with their friends to drive you to the border. No idea why they don’t have a system in place to prevent this from happening over and over. I guess the plan is get your money and scam you. We lost 1 day of our holiday because of this and still don’t have any refund yet, as it was them that cancelled our ticket not us. They said the flight took place so we have no right to a refund. Stay away from this company!!
reviews.author: Lianna

reviews.title: Denied boarding
reviews.text: Like others here, I was also denied to board the plane. They told me it was because I flew into Egypt through Cairo and not Sharm el Sheikh. I needed to be in Israel anyway, so I decided to take a taxi to Taba and cross the border there. I lost the money of the plane ticket plus an additional 100 usd for the taxi to the border. Be careful to book this ticket. It may seem like a good deal, but apparently they can deny you without any real reason, plus there is absolutely no information about this when you book the ticket. I am appalled that these scams happen and there is no law to protect the customer.
reviews.author: jiska1234

reviews.title: Really bad
reviews.text: The worse flight company in the world. Do not fly with it. Searching on what to charge money on. They took us 160 euro for two small bags because they decided each can have only backpack and that’s it

reviews.author: שירן ו

reviews.title: NEVER FLY ISRAIR!
reviews.text: I was denied boarding due 'government regulations'. They were very rude and literally kicked us out of the airport, saying just 'sorry'. Nobody warns you that you can not fly to Israel from Sharm el Sjeik under a foreign passport. They should warn for such things to not have those unpleasant surprises as a traveler. Now it seems impossible to get hold on them and no-one want to take responsibility. Had to buy a flight back to Cairo and puzzled a way back to Belgium via there. Never made it to Israel and lost 800 Euros. Never fly Israir, they don't take their responsibility nor respond when you try to reach them.
reviews.author: Alias T

reviews.title: ISRAIR is not an airline, but a gang of swindlers
reviews.text: This May in Sharm el Sheikh (Egypt) I was denied boarding my flight 6H992 SSH-TLV by Israeli Air Safety staff (Israir representative) and SSH airport staff. The given reason was that I had bought only one way trip SSH-TLV, thus I could not use that flight, as only return flight TLV-SSH-TLV could have been possible. So I had to buy a ticket to Cairo (51€), and then another ticket from Cairo to Tel Aviv (around 310€), and also had to stay necessarily at a Sharm el Shekh hotel for one night (77€), with total unexpected additional costs of around 438€. How could they sell me a one-way ticket SSH-TLV, if they did not allow to boarding one-way flights from Egypt? Besides, they even sold me one pc of luggage for this flight later, after the ticket had been bought, already knowing that I had a one-way, i. e. invalid ticket. The official claim was sent, but no reply was received (what a surprise...).
reviews.author: Viland V

reviews.title: Israir is now under new very incompetent management
reviews.text: Israir knew that Flight 6H726 would be delayed by over 4 hours but didn't reveal the delay on the airport's online or on-site departures board. The only indication of the impending delay was the 'compensation' meted out to the passengers upon arrival: a cellophane wrapped cake and a bottled beverage which was immediately binned by the airport's security personnel. I fainted while standing in line to board the plane but the Israir staff ignored my prone body while my husband tried to revive me. Obviously very ill, a stewardess offered me a cup of water when I finally boarded the plane but neither my husband nor most of the passengers were offered water during the entire flight. I emailed Israir, complaining about the flight, but have received no response to my complaint

reviews.title: This was a pretty bad trip
reviews.text: So when we got to the airport got through security clearly and got there we waited till 1:30 pm (when we were supposed to board) and we waited for thirty minutes no one of the staff was even there. We waited an hour more (by now an hour and thirty mins wait) and then they announced that a wheel broke and they needed to change it and that it will take about thirty minutes to do. Thirty minutes after that they told us it will take another hour (by now about three hours waited) they let us on the bus to the plane. On the plane the legroom was terrible (less than a tightly packed car) and no TV! (Only a boring book and safety instructions) And because of the delay I lost 3 hours of my trip. Basically pretty terrible at every category (oh and I forgot to mention two things! 1) they didn't even mention that the first delay (1.5 hours) 2) the bathroom wasn't very clean (I mean that)
reviews.author: Ariel S

reviews.title: Worst Airline Racist company to travel with!
reviews.text: After a great vacation with a friend in Rhodes, our vacation came to end and we had to travel back to Israel with Israir. The racist airline which decides who to check carefully according your nationality / language you speak. First check of the passports they let all the Israeli people to enter peacefully,and told me and my friend that they need to check our names because “our names doesn’t exist in the list of passengers for this flight”, then we had to show them the reservation that it’s the same flight, then took each one of us to different sides, and started to ask million questions about every personal thing in our lives. After that they didn’t allow us to take the small bag to the airplane (which is included in the ticket! ) because they “don’t have technologies” to Check the bag. And not to mention the delays in all their flights, an uncomfortable seats. Was a really bad experience. Never going to travel with such an airplane company.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: There was a long delay in taking off - and zero communication with pax. We just saw the departure time receding on the airport information screen. No-one at the gate. No SMS, no email, despite Israir having our information. Aircraft was very uncomfortable. Cramped and no recline.

reviews.title: What a flight!! OMG
reviews.text: Well, The pilot flew the plane like a kangaroo and landed as if he was an Albatross. That was a hell of a flight. we all felt we needed some time to recover
reviews.author: חדוה

reviews.title: Delays going to and returning from...
reviews.text: Very poor performance. On outgoing flight from TLV to Batumi they announced a three hour delay after I arrived at the airport. But in the end it turned into a four hour delay. Staff at the gate offered no clarification, and spent most of the time behind the doors of the gate so as to prevent interaction with customers. Delayed again on return flight, hopefully of only one hour (I write this from the airport lounge). Overall.... a very poor performance. Yet their prices are not budget by any means. Will avoid this airline as much as possible in the future.

reviews.title: ISRAIR SHOULD EITHER GET SERIOUS PROFESSIONAL HELP
reviews.text: Horrible in every aspect. It is a true shame. Everything from their website to their service needs to be reinvented. And in English. Israir should not me a member of IATA...... I have been a travel proffessional for over 40 years. I've never seen anything as bad as this.......
reviews.author: Helene T

reviews.title: Catastrophic experience with Israir flight
reviews.text: A flight which supposed to take ~ 2 hours, turned into a nightmare journey of 16 hours ! - It all started with a last minute alert of a technical fault in the airplane, continued with a long wait in the gate, followed by a transfer back to the city, then returning to the airport and go again through a second check-in procedure. Once back in the airport - 9 hours after the original departure time, we had to wait another 3 hours, just to find out there is another delay of 2 hours ..... All in all we have discovered that during all this waiting time the same defected airplane was waiting to be repaired. No one from the airline company was present neither has given any explanation or directive to about 250 passengers who were on this flight. The behaviour of this company is a disgrace. Their attitude as was exposed in this case was to consider their customers - the passengers - at the lowest priority. And make no mistake , this airline company HAS NO CUSTOMER SERVICE ! - it is simply impossible to get any representative, or call any phone number that will be answered. The only lesson they can learn is by passengers avoiding flying with them To say it in another words: Who ever decides to buy an airline ticket from this airline company - be sure not to expect any better experience than what we have .... - At least you won't be surprised..... and make sure to plan your traveling schedule so you can deal with such a hassle :-(
